comment: S21 Parts 3-4: the quest & rumor text pack v1 (docs/quest-text-pack-v1.md), planner-authored — wired as data, never rewritten here. Placeholders: {town} {region} {target} {card} {reward} {steps} {want}.

courier: A parcel for {town}, wrapped in oilcloth and questions. Don't open it. {reward} on delivery.
My sister in {town} needs this before the roads worsen. They always worsen.
This letter outlived two couriers already. Third time pays for all — {reward}, when it reaches {town}.
Take the ledger to {town}. Walk quickly and read nothing.
cardCourier: A collector in {town} wants {want} — wants it gone from here, more like. It travels the moment we shake on it.
The {want} in your keeping would settle an old debt in {town}. Old debts pay new gold.
There's a buyer in {town} for {want}. Ask no questions and carry none with it.
bounty: {target} has been seen on the {region} roads. The purse stands at {reward}, and it stands lonely.
Whatever walks the {region} wearing that shape — the reeve wants it stopped. {reward}, no questions on the manner.
Third caravan this season. The {region} pays {reward} to whoever ends it.
retrieval: It's in the lair in the {region} — past the resident, which is the whole trouble. Bring it back or keep it; we'll pay either way you choose wrong.
My grandmother's {card} went into that den with my grandmother. The {card}, at least, can come back.
The thing you want sits behind the thing you don't. {reward} if it reaches me.

chainLinks: Ask at {town} — the ferryman there saw where it went.
The shepherds in the {region} tell it differently. Go hear them tell it.
Old {town} charcoal-burners know that country. Buy a round and buy the truth.

guardians.reya: In the Last Chapel they bury no one twice. She won't allow it.
guardians.arcanis: The hermit of the Reach reads three futures in a breath. Bring him a fourth.
guardians.drana: The Barrowlands' mistress tithes in blood, and pays her debts in it too.
guardians.drakuseth: Brand's folk saw wings over the caldera at dusk. Three farms burned in a single pass.
guardians.titania: Fell a tree in the Deepwood, then count your breaths until the ground answers.

lords.unwinder: The tide at the Spire runs backward, and what it takes comes back wrong.
lords.usher: The duchess of the old court receives all the dead, and returns none.
lords.warden: The walls of the Bastion are alive, and the tallest of them holds the keys.
lords.stoker: Every spell spoken near the Furnace Gate, something inside hears it. And grows hungrier.
lords.sower: Plant nothing within sight of the Throne. It will grow, and it will not be yours.

rumors.moxPointer: There's a door in the {region} that opens for no key. Something older than keys waits behind it.
rumors.moxPointerDeep: Five doors, five sleepless things, five prizes that were old when the strongholds were quarried.
rumors.vaultTease: Five seats of power, five treasures taken. And beneath them all, they say — a flower.
rumors.nighthawkLegend: They found the last one drained white on the fen road, purse untouched. Walk wide of the Nighthawk — or walk in numbers, and count the payout worth it.
warp: The old currents run crosswise in this country. Some call it opportunity. Widows call it otherwise.
Five powers ride the crossed currents, and the riding frays the plane. Ask why the birds fly widdershins near the spokes' ends.
texture: The roads are the reeve's as far as the lanterns reach. Past that, they're whoever's walking them.
Whitewell's bell rings itself some mornings. Nobody mends it. Nobody dares.
The wild towns trade in things the civilized ones pretend not to want.
Steps are cheap, they say. They say it young.
rumors.manalinkPointer: There's work in {town} that pays in something better than coin. That kind of work doesn't wait.

corolla.doorOpen: Five seats stand empty, and the world has gone quiet spoke by spoke. What the lords rode has no riders now. The petals part.
corolla.doorLocked: The petals are closed. {n} seats still hold their sovereigns.
corolla.vaultOpen: Five gems, five sleepless things put to sleep. The Vault opens on what you carry — and shows it back to you.
corolla.vaultLocked: Locked. It counts gems, and you are short.

petals.B: The Court is dust. The Tithe still collects — here it wears the hearth's colours, and the collector smiles.
petals.R: The Gate is cold and the Toll is not. Something in the deep keeps the count, and it counts in depths.
petals.W: The Bastion's walls are down; the Intake stands. What arrives here arrives bound — and she moves first.
petals.U: The Spire is silent and the tide still rises. What is spent here grows back, and grows back wilder.
petals.G: The Throne is empty and the Season keeps its turning. Everything here musters. Everything here grows.

corolla.townStrip: The heart. The world stands still here, and so may you.
corolla.inn: Rest costs nothing here. Nothing is what time is worth, this deep.
corolla.shelf: The flower's own wares. Nowhere else stocks these; nowhere else could.
corolla.heartLocked: Five petals. {n} have fallen. The heart does not open for the impatient.
corolla.petalFalls: A petal falls. Its minister comes with you, and the two currents it kept.
corolla.mirrorYields: The reflection yields what it carried. There is exactly one, and now it is yours.
corolla.petalLost: The petal holds. You are left where you fell; the flower does not press its advantage.

heart.doorOpen: The petals are gone. What they grew from is waiting.
heart.telegraph: Here the currents meet. Five laws fell to you, and the thing that grew them has not fallen — it will grow them again as fast as you can cut them, one each night, in the order the plane runs. It has a name. You will read it on the card, and nowhere else. The heart does not offer terms.
heart.stakes: Nothing is wagered here. The flower has nothing to lose that it cannot regrow, and you have already given the road everything it asked.
heart.flavor: Five petals. Five laws. Five who thought the laws were theirs. Beneath them all, the flower — which never noticed it was being ruled.
heart.victory: The flower folds. The laws fall silent in the same breath, and the currents slow and feel for their old beds. This is not an ending. A petal closes; the world remembers who closed it. For now.
heart.victoryCard: Its card is yours. There is exactly one.
heart.loss: The flower stands. You are left at the heart, where nothing presses you. Rest, and return; it will be here.
heart.offer: Stay in the quiet world, or begin again on a new road — carrying what you carried out.

chronicle.W: Cut from the white road: the flower folded, and for a season the pale country's wounds did not close on their own. Whatever the flower was doing, it was doing that too.
chronicle.U: Cut from the blue road: the tide at the Spire ran forward for the first time anyone remembers. Then it thought better of it.
chronicle.B: Cut from the black road: the barrows were quiet, and then they were not quiet in a new way. The dead have opinions about flowers.
chronicle.R: Cut from the red road: the Caldera cooled a hand's breadth. Ash fell upward for a day.
chronicle.G: Cut from the green road: the Deepwood grew a ring of new trunks overnight, every one of them leaning toward the heart.

heart.fifthCutting: A cutting from every colour. The flower folds slower each time, and each time it folds, something under it turns over — like a sleeper deciding which side to face. The currents no longer run where they ran. Whatever comes next will not be Cinquefoil as you knew it.
heart.newRoad: You have cut the flower from the {colour} road. You begin with what you carried out: {power}, {guardian}, and {minister}.
heart.newRoadAll: You have cut the flower from every road. You begin with everything you carried out — and the plane has noticed.
heart.withheld: Its minister is already yours. The petal yields coin instead, and the two currents it kept.
heart.chronicleHeader: The Chronicle of Cuttings — the Manafleur, and what followed each folding.

door.refused: The gate knows your colours. It will not open to these.

byRule.minCreaturePower: Nothing small. The water takes the small things first.
byRule.minLandFraction: Half of what you bring must be ground.

bySite.tallyflame_court: Bring bodies to the fire. Twelve, at the least.
bySite.wrackroot_shallows: Nothing small. The water takes the small things first.
bySite.shevelport_green: No sudden things. The Green does not answer in the moment.
bySite.obsidian_observatory: Half of what you bring must be ground. The rest can be yours.
bySite.cairnbrand_pyre: Nothing dear. What you bring here, you will lose.

scene: For a breath the plane is still — stiller than it has ever been.
Then the stillness breaks. What the flower held, it holds no longer: the mana it stilled runs, and the low country goes under.
You keep your feet, and what you carried, and little else.
Ten faces you know. The rest is water.
flood.picks: From the wrack, five things — one of each colour — before the current takes them.
flood.pair: Two colours you will carry first. The rest can wait for dry ground.
flood.deep: The water is deep here. Whatever the flower was, it is under this now.

tidelock_weir.telegraph: The road ends at a wall of water held back by stone. Nothing on the far side is moving. A gate stands in the weir, and the gate is open, which is worse.
tidelock_weir.parley: "Property of the Weir," says the Bailiff, and does not say whose. "You may bring it in. You may not keep it long."
tidelock_weir.fall: The Weir is breached. The Bailiff's seizures are returned to the water, and the road runs through the stone.
tidelock_weir.prize: The Bailiff's writ, and the lands of the Weir.

marrowfen.telegraph: The bog is quiet in the way a full larder is quiet. Things are kept here. The path is a causeway of what the water took, packed down and walked on.
marrowfen.parley: "Everything that dies here is entered," says the Reeve. "Everything entered is mine to spend. You are not yet entered."
marrowfen.fall: Marrowfen is emptied. The Reeve's ledger closes on its last entry, and the bog gives back what it kept.
marrowfen.prize: The Reeve's ledger, and the lands of the fen.

emberford.telegraph: The water is shallow here, and warm, and wrong. Someone has been burning the river to keep the crossing. The ford is lit from underneath.
emberford.parley: "The toll is what you bring," says the Fordkeeper. "The river keeps the rest. Cross if you are certain."
emberford.fall: The ford goes dark. The Fordkeeper's fires drown, and the crossing is a crossing again.
emberford.prize: The Fordkeeper's brand, and the lands of the ford.

lockmere.telegraph: A valley became a lake, and someone built locks across it. The water is raised in steps. At the top step the lake is deeper than the valley was.
lockmere.parley: "Nothing is lost in a flood," says the Dredger. "Only sunk. I bring things up. I can bring them up again."
lockmere.fall: The locks open. What the Dredger raised runs down the steps and out, and the lake is a valley with water in it.
lockmere.prize: The Dredger's charter, and the lands of the mere.

harrowmoor.telegraph: The moor is furrowed like a field, and something is growing in the furrows. It is not grain. The rows are longer each time you look.
harrowmoor.parley: "The Sower sowed," says the Reaper. "I was what came up. Stand still, if you want to be counted with the harvest."
harrowmoor.fall: The furrows are cut. The Reaper's rows lie flat on the moor, and nothing comes up in them.
harrowmoor.prize: The Reaper's scythe, and the lands of the moor.

tallyflame_court.telegraph: An island in the deep water, and on it a court lit by a flame that does not warm. The flame counts. You can see it counting.
tallyflame_court.parley: "Every card you turn, I turn to fire," says Odile. "Bring your creatures. Bring many. The tally is kinder to the many."
tallyflame_court.fall: The Tallyflame gutters. Odile's count ends, and the court is a hall on a hill with a hearth in it.
tallyflame_court.prize: Tallyflame Court — the ground itself, dry — and Odile's tally.

wrackroot_shallows.telegraph: Roots break the surface of the deep water like the ribs of something drowned. The shallows between them are not shallow. Something moves under the tangle.
wrackroot_shallows.parley: "What leaves you, the water keeps," says Zinnia. "The small things it takes first. Bring nothing small."
wrackroot_shallows.fall: The undertow slackens. Zinnia's roots settle, and the shallows are shallow.
wrackroot_shallows.prize: Wrackroot — the ground itself, dry — and Zinnia's tangle.

shevelport_green.telegraph: One meadow above the flood, green as it was before, and greener. The court is a ring of standing things — stones, or something planted to look like stones. Nothing on the Green is sudden.
shevelport_green.parley: "Bring what lasts," says Ovna. "Set it down and leave it. The Green does not answer in the moment, and neither will you."
shevelport_green.fall: The Green goes fallow. Ovna's ring stands empty, and the meadow is a meadow.
shevelport_green.prize: Shevelport — the ground itself, dry — and Ovna's wreath.

obsidian_observatory.telegraph: A black tower on black rock, and from its top the whole flood is visible: where it rose, where it stopped, where it is rising still. Isaura has counted the ground that is left. She has counted yours.
obsidian_observatory.parley: "Half of what you bring must be ground," says Isaura. "The rest can be yours. The tower will see how much of yours there is."
obsidian_observatory.fall: The Observatory goes blind. Isaura's levy is disbanded, and the tower is a tower.
obsidian_observatory.prize: The Obsidian Observatory — the ground itself, dry — and Isaura's glass.

cairnbrand_pyre.telegraph: A cairn on the last dry rock, and on the cairn a fire that is fed with something. The smoke goes up and does not disperse. It is watching the water.
cairnbrand_pyre.parley: "Nothing dear," says Meliyan. "What you bring here, you will lose, and I will feel it go. Bring cheap things. Bring them in numbers."
cairnbrand_pyre.fall: The pyre goes out. Meliyan's smoke disperses, and the cairn is a cairn.
cairnbrand_pyre.prize: Cairnbrand — the ground itself, dry — and Meliyan's ember.

flood.fords: The water is deep here, and someone has laid a way across it — stones, or a boat that knows the way. It leads to dry ground.
flood.heartOpens: The fifth stronghold falls, and the deep water moves. Something under it has felt the last dam go. The way down is open.
flood.chronicleFifth: Five holds broken in the flood. The Calyx is open.

fount.telegraph: The deep water is not deep any more. It is rising. From the middle of it, where the flower stood, something is coming up that the flower stood on — five colours, and none of them still. The Cinquefont.
fount.parley: It does not speak. The water speaks: one law, then another, then all of them, then none, then one.
fount.fall: The fount is stopped. The water falls back to where it was, and it was never still. Something must be planted here.
fount.prize: A moment the tide did not take.

landing.name: Landing
landing.line: Dry ground, held. Whoever holds it holds a foot of the flood.

wellhouse.name: Wellhouse
wellhouse.line: A spring the water did not take. Something drinks here.
wellhouse.prize: The water gives back a little of what it took.

hearthstead.name: Hearthstead
hearthstead.line: A fire kept lit through the flood. Someone tends it, and does not share.
hearthstead.prize: The water gives back a little of what it took.
